_comment: Storage: the immutable, volatile, UTxO and ledger snapshot stores, the Haskell database and snapshot import, SCLS and Mithril (module storage). Its reference is ouroboros-consensus's storage layer and cardano-ledger's state encoders. Mapping it adds entries only: its code is under the format freeze (FMT-1). docs/design/correspondence-map.md says what an entry holds; scripts/check_correspondence.py checks it.

glue.reason: the decimal numbers in Scarab's own storage file names, written in ASCII digits under every locale; the reference writes the numbers of its own file names with show, which writes ASCII digits

the numbers of Scarab's own storage file names read back from ASCII digits only, and a name in a locale's digits refused as a typed error; the reference reads the numbers of its own file names with readMaybe, which takes ASCII digits only, and passes over a name it cannot read
